title: Concept: Kubernetes kubeconfig served
description: A kubeconfig is served at this endpoint, so the cluster API address, its certificate authority and the client credential it embeds are readable in one request.
applicability: Responses that serve files from a document root or a CI artefact store.
risk: The embedded token or client certificate authenticates to the cluster with the permissions of the identity it represents, which is often cluster-admin for a deployment kubeconfig; HIGH because the credential is directly usable.
